join.title: Join Our Revolution
join.description: Help us build the decentralized future of work and empower people around the globe

culture.title: Our Culture
culture.description: At BitTasker, we're building more than a platform—we're creating a movement. Our team is unified by a shared vision of economic freedom, decentralization, and peer-to-peer exchange without intermediaries.

why_join.description: Join a revolutionary team that's building the future of decentralized work, powered by Bitcoin and cutting-edge technology.

bitcoin_first.title: Bitcoin-First
bitcoin_first.description: We pay salaries in Bitcoin and believe in its power to transform the global economy.

fully_remote.title: Fully Remote
fully_remote.description: Work from anywhere in the world. We believe talent has no borders.

innovation_driven.title: Innovation-Driven
innovation_driven.description: We're pioneering the integration of Bitcoin, Lightning Network, and decentralized technologies.

mission_focused.title: Mission-Focused
mission_focused.description: We're committed to building tools that enhance financial sovereignty and economic freedom.

about.join: Join us in revolutionizing the future of work with Bitcoin and decentralized technologies!

careers.section_description: Explore our current opportunities and join the BitTasker movement.

dev.title: Full Stack Developer
dev.about_description: We're seeking passionate developers to help build the future of decentralized work. You'll be working with cutting-edge technologies to create a platform that empowers people worldwide to earn, trade, and thrive using Bitcoin.
dev.responsibility_1: Develop and maintain our lean, clean codebase and expand functionality
dev.responsibility_2: Expand and improve Bitcoin capabilities in our app
dev.responsibility_3: Leverage the power of Nostr to enhance users’ experience
dev.responsibility_5: Work with cutting-edge AI development tools and practices
dev.qual_1: Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, especially Svelte/SvelteKit
dev.qual_2: Knowledge of TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and responsive design
dev.qual_3: Experience with AI development tools and practices
dev.qual_4: Familiarity with the Bitcoin ecosystem and concepts
dev.qual_5: Interest in decentralized technologies and privacy-preserving systems
dev.qual_6: Strong problem-solving skills and commitment to clean code

pr.title: Public Relations Specialist
pr.about_description: We're looking for a strategic PR specialist to help spread BitTasker's message globally, with a special focus on El Salvador, the epicenter of the BitTasker circular economy revolution.
pr.responsibility_1: Develop and execute PR strategies focused on Bitcoin, decentralization, and the future of work
pr.responsibility_2: Build relationships with media outlets in El Salvador and internationally
pr.responsibility_3: Create compelling press releases, stories, and content about BitTasker's mission
pr.responsibility_4: Collaborate with marketing to ensure consistent messaging across all channels
pr.qual_1: Experience in PR, communications, or journalism
pr.qual_2: Fluency in Spanish and English required
pr.qual_3: Understanding of Bitcoin, cryptocurrency, and decentralized technologies
pr.qual_5: Experience with media relations in Latin America preferred
pr.qual_6: Existing relationships with relevant media outlets is a plus

media.title: Media Specialist/PR
media.about_description: We're seeking a media specialist and PR expert with deep knowledge of Bitcoin and cryptocurrency ecosystems to help BitTasker become the leading voice in decentralized work platforms.
media.responsibility_1: Develop and execute comprehensive media strategies focused on Bitcoin adoption and decentralized work
media.responsibility_2: Build relationships with cryptocurrency, tech, and business media outlets globally
media.responsibility_3: Create compelling content about BitTasker's mission and the future of work
media.responsibility_4: Manage crisis communications and maintain positive brand reputation in the crypto space
media.qual_1: Deep understanding of Bitcoin, cryptocurrency, and blockchain technologies
media.qual_2: Experience in PR, media relations, or communications
media.qual_3: Strong relationships with crypto and tech media outlets
media.qual_5: Experience with crisis management and brand protection
media.qual_6: Passion for decentralized technologies and financial freedom

ambassador.title: Brand Ambassador
ambassador.about_description: We're looking for passionate brand ambassadors to represent BitTasker at events, host gatherings, and bring more people onto our platform across Latin America, with a special focus on El Salvador.
ambassador.responsibility_1: Attend and represent BitTasker at Bitcoin and tech events across Latin America
ambassador.responsibility_2: Host local meetups and events to introduce people to BitTasker
ambassador.responsibility_3: Build relationships with local communities and organizations
ambassador.responsibility_4: Create content and share stories about BitTasker's impact in the region
ambassador.qual_1: Fluency in Spanish and English required
ambassador.qual_2: Experience with event planning and community building
ambassador.qual_3: Strong understanding of Bitcoin and cryptocurrency
ambassador.qual_5: Existing network in Latin American Bitcoin communities
ambassador.qual_6: Passion for financial inclusion and economic freedom

how_to_apply.title: How to Apply
how_to_apply.description: To apply for any of our open positions, please send your resume, LinkedIn profile, or Git repository links to our careers team. We look forward to learning more about you and your passion for building the future of decentralized work!
